fields.System.Title: RPL-203 — Create a replenishment task
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment operator, I want a task telling me what to move and where, so that
refilling a pick face is a normal piece of assigned work.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a need and a chosen source, then a task is created with source, destination,
  • product, batch, and quantity.
  • - Given the quantity, then it fills to the rule maximum, capped by pick face capacity
  • and by what the source holds.
  • - Given a task, then it is unassigned and available to any qualified operator.
  • - Given a task tied to a released wave, then it carries a higher priority.
  • - Given creation, then replenishment.task_created is published.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment |
| Tables | replen_task, outbox |
| Risks | Task quantity exceeding pick face capacity ([doc 05 WF 11](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
